joins: LEFT JOIN otm_bronze.carrier c ON c.carrier_gid = s.servprov_gid
columns:
shipment_leg_id = s.shipment_gid || '-' || s.stop_num
carrier_key = c.carrier_key
planned_arrival = s.planned_arrival
actual_arrival = s.actual_arrival
delay_hours = DATEDIFF(minute, s.planned_arrival, s.actual_arrival) / 60
updated_at = s.update_date
